verdict.rationale: Obsidian has no native automation engine in the evidence, but it offers building blocks. The Headless Sync client is pitched for CI pipelines, agents and automated workflows, and the Obsidian URI protocol lets external tools trigger actions such as creating notes. Users can also write TypeScript plugins against the Vault API to build their own background behaviour. Missing for 10: a first-party scheduler or trigger system for autonomous background automations, documented agent or automation workflows inside the app, and independent hands-on corroboration that such automations run reliably.
